turns.q: How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
turns.replyTail:
do I use it correctly to get the best result?
For the best results with our wax warmer + melts:



Read your warmer’s instructions first


Place the melt in the warmer dish


Use 2–3 Happy Wax bears for adjustable strength


For wax cubes, use no more than 1 at a time


Do not add water or oil


Turn the warmer on and, if needed, set a timer


Try different bear amounts or scent mixes to find your ideal strength



If you have any other questions or want tips on mixing scents, just let me know!
